StoreManagedAddresses.title: Store-managed addresses
StoreManagedAddresses.description: The storefront assigns the cart's addresses itself. Addresses that an AI assistant sends with a checkout are ignored, and the buyer chooses the address on the storefront's checkout page.

CheckoutLinkLifetimeMinutes.title: Checkout link lifetime (minutes)
CheckoutLinkLifetimeMinutes.description: How long a checkout link that an AI assistant gives the buyer stays valid. Default: 15.

CheckoutUrlTemplate.title: Checkout URL template
CheckoutUrlTemplate.description: The storefront page that opens a checkout link, with {token} for the link's token, for a checkout page that is not at /checkout. Leave empty to use {store URL}/checkout?ucp_session={token}.
